provenance: Original synthetic questions authored for DeepAuditCrossWalk. No NSW AIAF text is reproduced.

core_questions.question: Who owns the AI system's risk assessment and approval?
Which lifecycle stage and deployment boundary are being assessed?
What customer information can the AI access and why?
How are customers told about personal information collection and use?
What information security controls protect the AI system?
What human oversight applies to decisions and payment actions?
How can a customer challenge an AI-assisted outcome?
How are customer complaints recorded and assigned to an owner?
Which third-party services support the workflow?
Which business operations depend on this system?
How are operational risk assessments maintained?
What fallback and business continuity arrangements exist?
How are access rights granted and reviewed?
What audit logs record actions and approvals?
How are security incidents detected and escalated?
Who reviews identified deficiencies and remediation actions?

focus_questions.question: Has an information security control testing program been documented for this system?
What review process checks the third-party service provider's security assurance?
What risk-based testing frequency is specified for the information security controls?
